extracted.intended_audience: NSF proposers, grantees, research administrators, and institutional sponsored-research offices
extracted.subtask_description: Describes which version of the NSF Proposal & Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) governs proposal submission and awards, lists recent policy supplements and their effective dates, and links to related proposal/award resources. Used to determine applicable policies for preparing/submitting NSF proposals and managing awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: PAPPG as the authoritative source
rubrics_metrics.description: The Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) is the source for information about the proposal and award process at the U.S. National Science Foundation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PAPPG as the primary reference for NSF proposal and award rules and requirements when preparing proposals and managing awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Version applicability rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Each version of the PAPPG applies to all proposals or applications submitted while that version is effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine which version of the PAPPG is effective on the submission or due date of your proposal to know which policies apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current PAPPG version (NSF 24-1) effective date
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF 24-1 applies to all proposals submitted or due on or after May 20, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals with submission or due dates on/after May 20, 2024 must follow the requirements, formats, and policies set forth in NSF 24-1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy supplements implement changes to PAPPG 24-1
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy changes to PAPPG 24-1 are implemented via supplements (e.g., Supplement 1 (NSF 26-200), Supplement 2 (NSF 26-202)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for supplements to NSF 24-1 that may modify award-related policies; supplements may have their own applicability dates and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplement 1 (NSF 26-200) applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplement 1 (NSF 26-200) — Applies to all financial assistance awarded on or after Dec. 8, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For awards issued on or after Dec. 8, 2025, review Supplement 1 for policy changes affecting financial assistance terms and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplement 2 (NSF 26-202) applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplement 2 (NSF 26-202) — Applies to all financial assistance awarded on or after Jan. 22, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For awards issued on or after Jan. 22, 2026, review Supplement 2 for policy changes affecting financial assistance terms and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related resources and previous versions
rubrics_metrics.description: Related links: Additional Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures; Award Conditions; NSF Grants.gov Application Guide; list of previous PAPPG versions (NSF 23-1, 22-1, 20-1, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult related guides and prior PAPPG versions for historical policy context, award conditions, and Grants.gov-specific application procedures.
